mapper.select: SELECT ROUND(c.rent_total - c.rent_refund + c.late_total, 2) AS revenue, ROUND( (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(p.amount), 0) FROM payment_record p WHERE p.status = 'SUCCESS' AND p.pay_type = 'RENT' AND p.pay_time >= #{startDate}) - (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(r.amount), 0) FROM refund_record r WHERE r.status = 'REFUNDED' AND r.refund_type = 'CANCEL' AND r.refund_time >= #{startDate}) + (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.late_fee), 0) FROM lease_order o WHERE o.deleted = 0 AND o.late_fee > 0 AND o.return_time >= #{startDate}) , 2) AS rangeRevenue, ROUND(c.late_total, 2) AS lateFeeTotal, CASE WHEN c.paid_orders > 0 THEN ROUND((c.rent_total - c.rent_refund) / c.paid_orders, 2) ELSE 0 END AS avgOrderAmount, w.order_total AS orderTotal, w.paid_orders AS paidOrders, w.completed_orders AS completedOrders, w.cancelled_orders AS cancelledOrders, w.overdue_orders AS overdueOrders, s.vehicle_total AS vehicleTotal, s.vehicle_rented AS vehicleRented, s.user_total AS userTotal FROM (SELECT (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(p.amount), 0) FROM payment_record p WHERE p.status = 'SUCCESS' AND p.pay_type = 'RENT') AS rent_total, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(r.amount), 0) FROM refund_record r WHERE r.status = 'REFUNDED' AND r.refund_type = 'CANCEL') AS rent_refund, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.late_fee), 0) FROM lease_order o WHERE o.deleted = 0) AS late_total, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM payment_record p WHERE p.status = 'SUCCESS' AND p.pay_type = 'RENT') AS paid_orders ) c, (SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_total, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN pay_time IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS SIGNED) AS paid_orders, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS SIGNED) AS completed_orders, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'CANCELLED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS SIGNED) AS cancelled_orders, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(overdue_days, 0) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS SIGNED) AS overdue_orders FROM lease_order WHERE deleted = 0 AND create_time >= #{startDate} ) w, (SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM vehicle WHERE deleted = 0) AS vehicle_total, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM vehicle WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 2) AS vehicle_rented, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_user u JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.user_id = u.id JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.role_code = 'USER' WHERE u.deleted = 0) AS user_total ) s

SELECT t.d AS date, ROUND(SUM(t.rent), 2) AS rentAmount, CAST(SUM(t.order_cnt) AS SIGNED) AS orderCount, ROUND(SUM(t.late), 2) AS lateFee FROM ( SELECT DATE(p.pay_time) AS d, SUM(CASE WHEN p.pay_type = 'RENT' THEN p.amount ELSE 0 END) AS rent, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.pay_type = 'RENT' THEN p.order_id END) AS order_cnt, 0 AS late FROM payment_record p WHERE p.status = 'SUCCESS' AND p.pay_time >= #{startDate} GROUP BY DATE(p.pay_time) UNION ALL SELECT DATE(o.return_time) AS d, 0 AS rent, 0 AS order_cnt, SUM(o.late_fee) AS late FROM lease_order o WHERE o.deleted = 0 AND o.late_fee > 0 AND o.return_time >= #{startDate} GROUP BY DATE(o.return_time) ) t GROUP BY t.d ORDER BY t.d

SELECT COUNT(*) AS orderTotal, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN pay_time IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS SIGNED) AS paid, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN pickup_time IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS SIGNED) AS picked, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN return_time IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS SIGNED) AS returned, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS SIGNED) AS completed FROM lease_order WHERE deleted = 0 AND create_time >= #{startDate}

SELECT CASE v.status WHEN 1 THEN '可租' WHEN 2 THEN '已租出' WHEN 3 THEN '维保中' ELSE '其他' END AS name, CAST(COUNT(*) AS SIGNED) AS value FROM vehicle v WHERE v.deleted = 0 GROUP BY v.status ORDER BY v.status

SELECT s.id AS storeId, s.store_name AS storeName, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM vehicle v WHERE v.store_id = s.id AND v.deleted = 0) AS vehicleCount, CAST(COUNT(o.id) AS SIGNED) AS orderCount, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.pay_time IS NOT NULL THEN o.rent_amount ELSE 0 END), 0), 2) AS rentAmount, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(o.overdue_days, 0) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS SIGNED) AS overdueCount, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS SIGNED) AS completedCount FROM store s LEFT JOIN lease_order o ON o.store_id = s.id AND o.deleted = 0 AND o.create_time >= #{startDate} WHERE s.deleted = 0 GROUP BY s.id, s.store_name ORDER BY s.id

SELECT m.model_name AS modelName, b.brand_name AS brandName, CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS SIGNED) AS orderCount, ROUND(SUM(o.rent_amount), 2) AS rentAmount, ROUND(AVG(o.rent_days), 1) AS avgRentDays FROM lease_order o JOIN order_item oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN vehicle v ON v.id = oi.vehicle_id JOIN vehicle_model m ON m.id = v.model_id JOIN vehicle_brand b ON b.id = m.brand_id WHERE o.deleted = 0 AND o.pay_time IS NOT NULL AND o.create_time >= #{startDate} GROUP BY m.id, m.model_name, b.brand_name ORDER BY rentAmount DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT t.lv AS level, COALESCE(cr.rule_name, t.lv) AS levelLabel, COALESCE(cr.color, '#909399') AS color, CAST(COUNT(*) AS SIGNED) AS userCount, ROUND(AVG(t.sc), 1) AS avgScore, CAST(SUM(t.orders) AS SIGNED) AS orderCount, CAST(SUM(t.overdue) AS SIGNED) AS overdueCount, ROUND(SUM(t.rent), 2) AS rentAmount FROM ( SELECT u.id, u.credit_level AS lv, u.credit_score AS sc, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lease_order o WHERE o.user_id = u.id AND o.deleted = 0 AND o.create_time >= #{startDate}) AS orders, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lease_order o WHERE o.user_id = u.id AND o.deleted = 0 AND o.create_time >= #{startDate} AND COALESCE(o.overdue_days, 0) > 0) AS overdue, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.rent_amount), 0) FROM lease_order o WHERE o.user_id = u.id AND o.deleted = 0 AND o.pay_time IS NOT NULL AND o.create_time >= #{startDate}) AS rent FROM sys_user u JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.user_id = u.id JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.role_code = 'USER' WHERE u.deleted = 0 ) t LEFT JOIN credit_rule cr ON cr.rule_type = 'LEVEL' AND cr.rule_code = t.lv AND cr.status = 1 GROUP BY t.lv, cr.rule_name, cr.color, cr.sort_no ORDER BY COALESCE(cr.sort_no, 99)
